limitations.note: The rewrite removes the combinational feedback and passes at the default settings, but it also changes counter sizing, mode selection, and pulse widths under parameter overrides that the reference fix leaves alone.

The default check exercises the divider timing, but the override check expects the rewrite’s eight high ticks for divide-by-17 rather than the original threshold’s six, so it accepts the behavior change instead of catching it.
The agent reused a workaround documented for earlier threshold bugs even though the note itself flagged its different behavior for wider divisors and this task’s defect was in the mode flag.
